# Class parity scan fixture (AC-SCL-01; stories SCL-004, SCL-005). Read by
# StealthGame.Locomotion.ClassParity.Source (C++), .Blueprint and .NegativeControl, and
# StealthGame.Locomotion.AnimBpNoLocalControlRead. Format: see FStealthParityFixture::Parse in
# Source/StealthFoundation/Public/Server/Testing/StealthClassParityScan.h.
#
# Forbidden symbols: ADR-0013 section 1 (IsLocallyControlled, IsPlayerControlled, GetController,
# PlayerState, any local-control flag) plus IsBotControlled (SCL-004 QA clarification), the
# controller-class and PlayerState types (ADR-0001 section 1, ADR-0010 "Kind-blind code") and Roster
# queries. The local-control set is bounded by the flags enumerated in spikes S1/S2/S14
# (production/qa/spikes/2026-10-25_S1-S2-S14.md section 3).

local-control IsLocallyControlled
local-control IsLocallyViewed
local-control IsLocalController
local-control IsLocalPlayerController
forbid IsPlayerControlled
forbid IsBotControlled
forbid GetController
forbid GetInstigatorController
forbid GetPlayerState
forbid PlayerState
forbid APlayerState
forbid PlayerController
forbid APlayerController
forbid AIController
forbid AAIController
forbid-cpp Controller
forbid-prefix Roster
forbid-prefix IRoster
forbid-prefix URoster
forbid-prefix FRoster

# Scan roots. C++: the Shared Pawn, its movement and motion-warping components (Core/SharedPawn and
# their View/Core headers) and the AnimInstance (Core/Animation, View/Animation). The step clock and
# footstep code are added here when they exist (SCL-043; ADR-0013 section 6).
root-cpp Source/StealthGameplay/Private/Core/SharedPawn
root-cpp Source/StealthGameplay/Public/View/Core
root-cpp Source/StealthGameplay/Private/Core/Animation
root-cpp Source/StealthGameplay/Public/View/Animation

# Blueprint roots: the pawn's Blueprint (CBP_SandboxCharacter, still parented to the prototype
# AStealthCharacter until the reparent Content step) and the one AnimBP. Linked layers and Blueprint
# parents are followed by the walker.
root-bp /Game/Blueprints/CBP_SandboxCharacter.CBP_SandboxCharacter
root-bp /Game/Blueprints/ABP_SandboxCharacter.ABP_SandboxCharacter

# R9 owner-local allowlist (SCL R9: camera, own head hide, input binding). root|scope|token|reason
# CBP_SandboxCharacter SetupCamera / SetupInput read the pawn's own controller to bind the camera and
# Enhanced Input; spike S14 found both reached only from EventPossessed -> EventPossessed_Client (an
# owner-client call), so they change nothing another client or the host can observe of this body.
allow /Game/Blueprints/CBP_SandboxCharacter.CBP_SandboxCharacter|SetupCamera|GetController|R9 camera: owner-local camera setup (spike S14 section 3)
allow /Game/Blueprints/CBP_SandboxCharacter.CBP_SandboxCharacter|SetupCamera|PlayerController|R9 camera: casts its own controller to bind the camera (spike S14 section 3)
allow /Game/Blueprints/CBP_SandboxCharacter.CBP_SandboxCharacter|SetupInput|GetController|R9 input binding: owner-local Enhanced Input setup (spike S14 section 3)
allow /Game/Blueprints/CBP_SandboxCharacter.CBP_SandboxCharacter|SetupInput|PlayerController|R9 input binding: Enhanced Input subsystem of its own controller (spike S14 section 3)
